pages.name: Herald of Storm
pages.text: First in the cycle. It opens the trials.

pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Its arrival brings overcast weather and a constant gale. The wind throws the player back, even in Spirit Form, and arrows and other suitable projectiles are deflected.

pages.title: How to defeat it
pages.text: $(#2E7D4F)Spirit Step$(): teleport straight to the Herald, then strike in melee while the brief window of knockback immunity lasts.$(br2)Ordinary ranged attacks are unreliable, and Spirit Form does not stop the knockback.

pages.title: Reward
pages.text: Victory leaves a $(item)Heart of Storm$(), embodying the Path of Movement. If you lose, the Herald vanishes and no heart drops.
